United States This position is not eligible for employer sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work and must not require employer sponsorship.  
  
  
 Location: 
20 E Thomas Rd, Phoenix, Arizona 85012 United States of America 
 
 To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews and assessments independently and without the use of artificial intelligence tools (including AI-generated responses, prompts, or real-time assistance). Use of AI throughout the application and recruiting process may result in removal from consideration. Our goal is to get to know your authentic experiences, communication style, and problem-solving approach. 


 This is a fully onsite position located at our corporate campus in Phoenix, AZ. There is no opportunity for remote work. 


 We are seeking a professional Software Development Engineer in Test to join our U-Haul family and support our applications. As a Software Development Engineer in Test, you will be responsible for meeting commitments and delivering automation testing activities and schedules. You will be responsible for testing activities of new features developed, collaborating with the team to identify issues, track progress and ensure their successful resolution by developers. You must be self-driven, meticulous and think outside the box. You must be a team player and work with development and Quality Assurance within a scrumban or kanban set up.


 Job Description: 

 Respond to Software Quality issues with related groups such as Development, Database, Integration and Customer Support.
 Work within an Agile team, collaborating with developers, QA, Support and Stakeholders to meet business requirements and system goals, fulfill end user requirements and identify and resolve systems issues effectively throughout the Software Development Life Cycle.
 Perform execution of GUI, functional, performance, integration, UAT, Blackbox, regression and roll-back testing scenarios in areas such as User Interface (UI), Web Service and database technologies.
 Assist development team with analysis from a quality analysis perspective and assist in identification of edge case scenarios or areas of potential performance impact.
 Participate in pre-release and post-release sanity testing activities and processes, while additionally maintaining and enhancing documentation which will serve to increase the overall operational efficiency of the application.
 Assist in root cause analysis and mitigation strategies.
 
 Requirements: 

 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics
 1-2+ years experience as Software Engineer test or similar role with full SDLC and STLC, software testing best practices and principles within Waterfall, SCRUM and Kanban methods
 1-2+ years experience coding in .Net, c#, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cross Browser tools like Browserstack, Lambda Test
 Experience with WebDriver, REST Web services & SOAP (Postman, SOAP UI or similar) and SQL
 Working experience with scrum teams, DevOps model code through CI/CD pipeline
 Must exhibit excellent analytical and problem identification skills
 Must be good with communication and be an independent thinker
 Must be available to work after hours for release support
  
 About the U-Haul IT Team: 

 The technology staff at U-Haul understands that exceptional software and systems designs are integral to not only serving our users but enabling us to be the leaders in software development within our industry. The ability to quickly pivot as demands arise supported by a foundation of emphasis on Agile team collaboration that are key to delivering world class solutions. No idea too small, no endeavor too big as we embrace the mantra everyone is capable of contributing value and that the total effectiveness of a group interacting with one another is far greater than the sum of its parts.

 U-Haul Holding Company, and its family of companies including U-Haul International, Inc. (“U-Haul”), continually strives to create a culture of health and wellness. Consistent with applicable state law, U-Haul will not hire or re-hire individuals who use nicotine products.  The states in which U-Haul will decline to hire nicotine users are: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, and Washington. U-Haul has observed this hiring practice since February 1, 2020 as part of our commitment to a healthy work environment for our team.   
 
 
 U-Haul is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, provincial, state or local law. Individual accommodations are available on requests for applicants taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Information obtained during this process will only be shared on a need to know basis.
